messages.subject: error messages downloading r-inla
parts:
hello,
I tried to download r-inla and got this error messages.  I am using R version 2.15.2 (2012-10-26) -- "Trick or Treat"
what is going on?  

Thank you

> source("http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/givemeINLA.R")
trying URL 'http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/binaries/INLA.tgz'
Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 38812962 bytes (37.0 Mb)
opened URL
==================================================
downloaded 37.0 Mb

ERROR: dependencies ‘pixmap’, ‘sp’ are not available for package ‘INLA’
* removing ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.15/Resources/library/INLA’
Error in library(INLA, lib.loc = lib) : there is no package called ‘INLA’
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE,  :
  there is no package called ‘pixmap’
2: In inla.installer(...) :
  INLA need package `pixmap' to be fully functional; please install
3: In library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE,  :
  there is no package called ‘sp’
4: In inla.installer(...) :
  INLA need package `sp' to be fully functional; please install
5: In install.packages(dfile, lib = lib, repos = NULL, type = tp) :
  installation of package ‘/var/folders/JR/JRGKFpq2Fw4IgZMQksyHVU+++TI/-Tmp-//RtmpUqyN7k/INLA.tgz’ had non-zero exit status
> inla.upgrade(testing=TRUE)
Error: could not find function "inla.upgrade"

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] error messages downloading r-inla
parts:
On 17/03/13 19:48, Tran Huynh wrote:
> hello,
> I tried to download r-inla and got this error messages. I am using R
> version 2.15.2 (2012-10-26) -- "Trick or Treat"
> what is going on?

As indicated by the error messages, INLA requires the pixmap and sp
packages. Do you have them installed? If not, try to install them
yourself. If they are already installed, upgrade them. Then try to
install INLA again.

Finn
